brief: Transparent-pricing wardrobe staples - tees, denim, work-appropriate pants. Our shopper is mid-career, cares about where stuff is made, spends $100-150 per order.

profile.business_summary: Transparent-pricing DTC brand offering wardrobe staples such as tees, denim, and work-appropriate pants. Targets mid-career shoppers who value manufacturing transparency and have an average order value of $100-150.
stated_claims: Cares about where stuff is made

relevant_tags.why: Core product category is wardrobe staples including tees, denim, and pants.
Sells everyday wardrobe staples like tees.
Sells work-appropriate pants suitable for mid-career professionals.
Sells casual staples like denim and tees.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click (verifiable without trusting a pixel). Market price to win a page view on these hosts: $0.56-$0.74 per click (median $0.64), from the simulated auction against the other campaigns. 'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
